name: Bodily autonomy
description: Derived principle: persons have substantial authority over what happens to their own bodies, including medical decisions.
foundationStrengthRationale: Widely recognized in medical ethics and law, though boundaries remain contested at the edges.

pros.claim: Aligns with widely accepted informed consent frameworks in clinical practice.
pros.evidence: Informed consent is a standard requirement across modern healthcare systems.

cons.claim: May conflict with public health measures that require mandatory interventions.
cons.evidence: Vaccination mandates and quarantine powers illustrate recurring tension between autonomy and collective welfare.

public-health-tension-note.title: Public health vs. individual autonomy — introductory note
